newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAS, JAL to get more slots at Haneda - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: JAS, JAL to get more slots at Haneda - Jiji.

text.p: The Transport Ministry has decided to allocate 13 new slots to Japan Air System Co Ltd (JAS) and 12 new slots to Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL) out of an expected 40 new slots at Tokyo's Haneda Airport, Japan's Jiji news agency said on Thursday.
Jiji said that All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) would be allocated nine new slots and new airlines would get six slots.
Four groups have already announced that they are interested in forming new airline companies, Jiji said.
Ministry officials declined to comment on the report.
A third runway is due to open at the Tokyo International Airport at Haneda, which is mainly a domestic airport, later this month.
Currently ANA has the largest domestic network in Japan, with around a 50 percent share of the Japanese market.
